# Input Base

```tsx
import { InputAction, InputClearButton, InputLabel, InputMessage, InputRoot, clearControl, inputControlClassName, inputFieldClassName, inputIconClassName, useInputBase } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

## Figma notes

Pieces shared by the Figma Input components (Input Text, Input Number, Input Search, Input Password, Input Area): Field, Button Clear and Text Help / Text Error, plus the Label component. The root carries data-state (default / disabled / read-only), data-invalid and data-filled for the `group/input` variants below.
The field draws its hover overlay with ::after under the content, like the stacked fills in Figma, and the Focus / Focus Error ring as an outline 2px away from the border. Read Only can't be edited, so it has no Focus and leaves the tab order.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`InputBaseProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `label?` | `React.ReactNode` | The .Label above the field. |
| `requirement?` | `React.ReactNode` | Text after the label, like "(obrigatório)" or "(opcional)". |
| `info?` | `React.ReactNode` | Shows the Info icon next to the label with this content in a tooltip. |
| `helpText?` | `React.ReactNode` | Text Help below the field. Hidden while an error is shown. |
| `error?` | `React.ReactNode` | Error=True: paints the Focus Error ring and shows this as Text Error. |
| `clearable?` | `boolean` | Shows Button Clear while the field is filled. |
| `clearLabel?` | `string` | Accessible name of Button Clear. |
| `fieldClassName?` | `string` | Classes for the bordered field, the root takes `className`. |

## Types

`InputBaseProps`, `InputState`

## Rules

- Import `InputAction` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
